name: My Little Sister (Yandere)
source:
A story about a brother who loves his his too much to let her go. Maybe it's some sort of trauma. Or maybe it's a coping mechanism.... Or maybe it's both...

[From [url=https://zombies-cat.itch.io/my-little-sister]Itch.io[/url]]
